translations.ko: 하나님이 노아에게 말씀하셨다. “모든 육체의 끝이 내 앞에 이르렀다. 그들 때문에 땅에 폭력이 가득 찼으니, 보라, 내가 그들을 땅과 함께 멸하겠다.
translations.en: God said to Noah, “The end of all flesh has come before me, for the earth is filled with violence because of them. Behold, I am about to destroy them with the earth.
translations.es: Dios dijo a Noé: «El fin de toda carne ha llegado ante mí, porque la tierra está llena de violencia por causa de ellos. Mira, voy a destruirlos junto con la tierra.

translations.en: Make yourself an ark of gopher wood. Make compartments in the ark, and coat it inside and out with pitch.
translations.es: Hazte un arca de madera de gófer. Haz compartimentos en el arca y recúbrela por dentro y por fuera con brea.
